title: Introducing ChatGPT Futures: Class of 2026
summary: Meet the ChatGPT Futures Class of 2026—26 student innovators using AI to build, research, and drive real-world impact. Discover how this generation is redefining learning, creativity, and opportunity with ChatGPT.
body: Meet the ChatGPT Futures Class of 2026—26 student innovators using AI to build, research, and drive real-world impact. Discover how this generation is redefining learning, creativity, and opportunity with ChatGPT.
summaryZh: OpenAI介绍了“ChatGPT Futures”2026届学生创新者项目，旨在展示学生如何利用AI进行研究与创作。该内容主要侧重于品牌形象建设与人才培养，不涉及模型技术层面的实质性进展。
